title: Lead AI Engineer
description: Lead AI Engineer at Yellow Tech. I design the architecture, the AI writes the code, I review and ship.

ui.pageNotFoundNear: The address is a little off.
ui.pageNotFoundFar: There is nothing here, and nothing like it.
ui.pageNotFoundHint: The list has everything, or ask the agent.
ui.notFoundAskText: I was looking for {path}, but the page does not exist. Where do I find what I was after?
ui.serverErrorText: The error is on my side, not yours. Try again in a moment.
ui.serverErrorQuote: If it keeps happening, write to me and quote the code above.
ui.serverErrorNoCode: If it keeps happening, write to me.
ui.agentUnreachable: the agent is not answering, retrying by itself
ui.agentNoScript: The agent needs JavaScript. The rest of the site works without it.
ui.agentNoticeOfftopic: I will pass on this one: I am the agent on Simone's site, and my field is his projects, his code and the way he works. Ask me anything there.
ui.agentNoticeAbuse: I will not run this request.
ui.agentNoticeRate: You are going a bit fast: try again in a minute.
ui.agentNoticeBudget: You have used today's credits for the agent: they come back at {time}. Meanwhile you can write to me from the contact page.
ui.agentRetrying: the model did not answer, retrying
ui.agentErrorProvider: The model is not available right now, even after retrying.
ui.agentErrorTimeout: The answer took too long and I stopped it. A narrower question usually gets through.
ui.agentErrorAborted: You stopped the answer. What had arrived stays above.
ui.agentErrorInternal: Something broke on my side. Try again; if it keeps happening, write to me.
ui.agentToolsNote: Before each message Jev decides whether it is on topic, in about 300 ms. Under each answer: tokens and credits used.
ui.agentToolSearch: searches projects, writing, method and now
ui.agentToolRead: reads a whole page of the site
ui.agentAsk1: What is the difference between Relay and Portsage?
ui.agentAsk2: How does Simone work with coding agents?
ui.agentAsk3: What is he working on right now?
ui.agentToolProjects: lists the projects, by state or tag
ui.agentToolShow: shows you a page to open
ui.agentToolRepo: a public repo at a glance: languages, README, last push
ui.agentToolFiles: the file tree of a repo
ui.agentToolFile: reads a file, with line numbers
ui.agentToolCode: searches the code of a repo
ui.agentToolCommits: the latest commits of a repo
ui.agentToolRun: writes and runs JavaScript that calls the other tools, in a sandbox with no network
ui.agentToolDelegate: splits a broad question between 2 or 3 sub-agents in parallel
ui.agentToolDraft: drafts a message to Simone that you send
ui.agentDraft: draft to Simone, you send it
ui.agentDraftContact: your email or a contact, if you want a reply
ui.agentAsk4: How does Portsage know which ports are taken? Show me the code

sectionDescriptions.projects: Things I built and things I'm building: products, developer tools, AI experiments and a few ideas still on paper.
sectionDescriptions.articles: Articles and notes on architecture, coding agents and how work changes when the AI writes the code.
sectionDescriptions.method: How I work with coding agents: architecture before code, context as the work, measuring instead of trusting.
sectionDescriptions.now: What I'm working on right now, updated from the projects.
sectionDescriptions.about: Who I am, where I come from and how to reach me.
sectionDescriptions.agent: An agent with real tools that works on my projects and shows how: every call, the tokens and the cost.
sectionDescriptions.privacy: What data the site collects, why, where it goes and how long it stays: cookieless statistics, conversations with the agent, messages to me.
